tasks.implementation_notes: 2026-11-17, DONE on the evidence below. Defect (found by the MDD-052 review): a SQL statement with ten nested parentheses of OR/LIKE, or a flat OR of twenty terms, ended the engine process with a stack overflow (0xC00000FD) in a debug build. Reproduced by artifacts/mdd-084/repro_or_chain_overflow.py against the unfixed build (exit 3221225725 on depth 10, depth 11, depth 10 with a 64-character prefix and a flat OR of 20; depth 9 passes; depth 60 is refused by the lexical depth quota), and after the fix none of the six cases crashes, the admitted ones answer complete and ok, the over-limit one is a structured QUOTA_EXCEEDED with no rows. Cause: predicate() kept the leaf match inside the recursive function, a frame of tens of kilobytes in a debug build; the SQL rewrite (ast.rs) also recursed on the caller's stack. Fix: crates/mdd-query/src/operators/mod.rs predicate_at recurses through a small frame with the leaf evaluation out of line (#[inline(never)]), refuses a predicate deeper than 64 with PREDICATE_DEPTH_LIMIT (validation already did; the evaluator now does as well), and charges one step per node as before (parent first, left before right, no short-circuit); like_reference keeps its backtracking on the heap with the same charge per state; crates/mdd-sql/src/dialects/ast.rs runs the recursive rewrite on a 16 MiB thread and caps its depth at 64 (the default max_ast_depth is 48 and unchanged), failing closed with QUOTA_EXCEEDED / SQL_AST_NODE_OR_DEPTH, and a thread that cannot start or that panics is an INTERNAL_FAULT, never an empty success. An earlier draft evaluated deep predicates on a heap stack; the mutation sample showed that variant equivalent once the frame was small, so the simpler recursive form with an allocation-free row path was kept (the evaluator runs per row). Tests: mdd-query 206 and mdd-sql 255 lib tests, among them depth 1 to 64 chains in both dialects on a 1 MiB stack, 420 random boolean trees against an independent fold, the evaluator's own depth refusal, a 256-token reference LIKE pattern on a 1 MiB stack, and the rewrite on a 1 MiB caller stack at depth 9 to 11 with 64-character prefixes; the golden query replay (77 cases, 145 pages) and the process tests are unchanged. Mutation check: all 12 faults killed on Actions (run 44038496922 on afd08e4; four parts and a clean-tree job in about four minutes; the restored tree passes), result in artifacts/mdd-084/mutation/results.txt. NOT RUN: a release build; Linux locally (the repository CI runs the debug tests and the reproduction).
